author: Realmoglijones
quote: I’ve played ever GTA game ever made. This one is Torture. GTA 6 is like if TradCon men just took over 50 shades of grey and forced all of these promiscuous women reading it into some chastity belt challenge that unlocks after they finish reading endless chapters about being loyal to one man. Why would you ruin die hard fans safe space like that? Do they understand what they did? Hopefully that can help clear things up because it’s essentially like the turning point in Gane of Thrones where everything just went downhill and the Fans were disrespected by the result.
